## MESHH TUI v0.1.2

Maintenance release for the MESHH terminal client.

### Changes

- Add `meshh update --check` and `meshh update` for release update checks and verified self-updates.
- Show a cached TUI update notice when a newer installable release is available.
- Install updates from immutable GitHub Release assets with SHA256 verification and archive validation.
- Harden update installation with private temporary directories and duplicate-entry checks.
- Keep update notices platform-aware so unsupported release assets do not produce misleading prompts.

### Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/meshhai/meshh-tui/master/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

### Artifacts

- `meshh_0.1.2_aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz`
- `meshh_0.1.2_x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz`
- `meshh_0.1.2_x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz`
- `meshh_0.1.2_x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip`

Each archive is published with a matching `.sha256` checksum file.
